key_insight: SUMNO turns a multigrid V-cycle into a U-shaped neural operator, achieving strong fluid-flow predictions with 9.4 million parameters.
engineering_relevance: The architecture offers a compact surrogate for regular-grid CFD, with improved rollout accuracy across several flow benchmarks.
method: Spatially unrolls a V-cycle using parameter-free down/up sampling and additive skip connections.
Keeps transfer and skip pathways normalization-free.
Combines fine-scale convolutions with coarsest-scale shifted-window attention supporting periodicity independently per axis.
evidence_signal: Across four flow benchmarks and five baselines, SUMNO ranks first in 5 of 7 settings and second in two, reducing 10-step rollout MSE by about 30% versus the strongest baseline.
watch_item: The reported evaluation uses regular grids; applicability to unstructured meshes and longer rollout stability remain unestablished.
paper_title: SUMNO: Spatially Unrolled Multigrid Neural Operator for Fluid Flow Surrogates
